game_title: The Lost Legacy of C · Procedural classification
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Stalactite Hall, a hall of dripping stalactites: the lantern keeper must handle slime blobs while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Stalactite Hall: a hall of dripping stalactites
core_gameplay_loop: Search the archive, examine recovered computing artifacts, and use their evidence to verify the assigned C lesson.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Case 9: Find 5 artifacts, read the evidence, and verify three findings about Procedural classification.
controls: Select objects in the room. Review discovered objects in Evidence and verify your findings. Tab and Enter select controls. Escape closes a card or pauses.
win_condition: Recover all 5 artifacts and answer all three evidence checks correctly.
lose_condition: The case ends when the available incorrect evidence checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared archive artwork, illustrated artifacts, and Kenney interface audio.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Loop Counter Conveyor' (Week 4 slot 9), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Stalactite Hall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Match the silhouettes in the tray to the objects in the room.
Inspect each artifact to read its history.
Open Evidence to review the records and verify your findings.
source_player_objective: Reach the cave gate using at most 20 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The cave gate reached with actions_used <= 20.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 20 before the cave gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Loop Counter Conveyor – Stalactite Hall Trial
hint: Match an unfound object in the tray to its shape in the room. The Evidence folder keeps every record you uncover.
